name: correlate_page_results_tool
description: Correlates outputs from multiple specialists for a single page into a unified_document structure. Call this AFTER running 2+ specialists on the same page. Takes S3 URIs of specialist results (full_text required as spine, plus diagram/table/chart/etc.), produces a correlated unified_document with enrichments attached to the content spine, saves to S3, and returns the S3 URI with a brief summary. Do NOT call for pages with only one specialist result.

full_text_uri.description: S3 URI of the full_text_specialist result (required as canonical spine)

specialist_name.description: Name of the specialist (e.g., diagram, table, chart)

s3_uri.description: S3 URI of the specialist result

specialist_uris.description: Array of other specialist results to correlate with full_text

page_number.description: Page number or identifier for this correlation

correlation_specialist_uri.description: S3 URI of the saved correlation_specialist output

summary.description: Brief summary of the correlation results
